text:
Jamie (AE): Cascade just sent an RFP asking for: POC plan, pricing bands, completed security questionnaire, and a capability matrix comparing hosted / dedicated / private (they specifically called out HSM/KMS). Buyer wants a response by EOD Friday. Can SEs/Product/Legal coordinate? I can upload the PDF here.

Raj V: On it. Quick clarifying Qs — do they require on-prem for the POC or will VPC/private cloud be fine? Also any hard targets for throughput/latency for the POC so we size Dedicated appropriately?

Jamie (AE): They said private preferred with HSM for production, but said hosted or Dedicated is fine for the initial POC if it's faster to stand up. POC targets from the buyer: ~50 qps, ~100k tokens/day, 95th p99 latency < 500ms. I'll confirm if those are strict.

Emma S: I can draft the capability matrix today. Quick high-level snippet below:
```
- Hosted: managed API, model catalog, streaming, no HSM (KMS only), quick onboarding
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools, configurable autoscaling, optional KMS/HSM integration (via private peering), SLA-backed latency
- Private: VPC or on-prem appliance, customer-managed HSM/KMS, audit logs, SOC2 +3rd-party attestations
```
Link to internal matrix: https://redwood.internal/rdx/capability-matrix (internal). I'll export CSV after we agree fields. :memo:

Marta L: Legal needs copies of their SOC2 or any compliance questionnaires they require if they're asking about HSM. Also want the DPA questions answered and flag that on-prem with customer HSM may trigger export control / data transfer clauses. We typically need 3 business days to review redlines.

Legal: Please add requirement for certificate of destruction / data deletion after POC and the specifics on access control for customer keys.

Raj V: Proposed POC timeline (draft):
- Week 0: paperwork + account access, confirm dataset and T&Cs
- Week 1: infra provisioning (Dedicated pool / private setup), connectivity (VPC peering), KMS/HSM onboarding
- Week 2: run workloads, perf + cost measurement, gather logs and traces
- Week 3: evaluation + handoff + agreed deliverables (report + matrix + retention ops)
I'll draft a playbook and checklist.

Raj V: Quick deploy snippet for internal runbook:
```
redwood deploy --mode dedicated --pool cascade-poc --model redwood-vicuna-13b --region us-west-2
# set concurrency/limits in config:
redwood config set cascade-poc batch_size=16 max_latency_ms=500
```

DeployBot: Automated: Dedicated pool 'cascade-poc' (us-west-2) currently shows 2/4 GPUs available. Next maintenance window Thu 02:00-03:00 UTC.

Jamie (AE): Thanks. I'm uploading the RFP PDF and security questionnaire now. Attached: cascade_rfp.pdf, cascade_security_questionnaire.xlsx. I'll also confirm if their PII residency requirement is strict.

Emma S: For pricing — recommended approach for POC: hosted credits for quick eval (one-time $10k credit) OR Dedicated POC discount (50% off committed hourly rate for first 30 days, cap at $8k) + private deployment is quoted as license + integration T&M. I'll put numbers in the pricing sheet and mark assumptions. :dollar:

Marta L: Add clause requiring deletion confirmation after POC and an agreed retention window. Also ask for proof of HSM requirements (FIPS 140-2/3 level, HSM vendor) so we can map to our integrations.

Raj V: I'll produce the capability_matrix_cascade.csv and a short written response file for each security question (answers keyed to questionnaire row IDs). ETA: Thursday 12:00 PT.

Jamie (AE): Great — I'll keep buyer warm and ask for any missing details. @Marta L please standby to accelerate review once Raj drops the draft answers.

Marta L: Ack. Ping me when draft is posted.

Emma S: Uploaded files to the thread: capability-matrix_cascade_v1.csv, pricing_summary_cascade_v1.xlsx. Added a small notes tab with assumptions and the POC pricing cap.

Jamie (AE): Perfect. I'll assemble the cover note and ship initial response with attachments tomorrow morning. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Raj V: I'll drop the checklist and runbook in the sales playbook repo and tag the thread when done.

DeployBot: Note: ticket CREATED-4821 for provisioning cascade-poc (assigned to infra-scheduling).

Jamie (AE): Closing loop — buyer meeting scheduled Wed 10am PT to walk through the plan. I'll invite SE + Legal.

Marta L: I'll make time for the Wed call. Please share the questionnaire answers before then.

Emma S: I'll revise matrix after buyer confirms HSM specifics.

(attachments referenced: cascade_rfp.pdf, cascade_security_questionnaire.xlsx, capability-matrix_cascade_v1.csv, pricing_summary_cascade_v1.xlsx)
